Method of Attack: Phishing websites trick users into approving malicious smart contracts that drain funds from cryptocurrency wallets without consent
Malicious ads on Google and Twitter promoting phishing sites
Exploitation of Google Ads tracking template loophole to spoof URLs
Use of geofencing to target specific regions
Use of hacked verified Twitter accounts to post scam ads
Impacted Systems: Cryptocurrency wallets on Ethereum chain and DeFi platforms like Zapper, Lido, Stargate, Defillama, Orbiter Finance, Radiant
Attack Vector: Malicious advertisements on Google Search and Twitter (X)
Malware infection of Twitter accounts to post scam ads
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious ads exploiting Google Ads tracking template loophole
Verified Twitter accounts posting scam ads
Sites promoting 'Ordinals Bubbles' NFT collection and NFT airdrops with drainer
